critique.evidence: Measured loading is demo-ready across viewports: LCP is 1700 ms desktop, 1644 ms tablet, and 516 ms mobile; FCP is 116/164/68 ms; TTFB is 8.6/5.4/2.5 ms. CLS is excellent on desktop (0.00046) and mobile (0), though tablet reaches 0.0478. There is no horizontal overflow and no console, page, or request failure. The main limitations are a heavy 1,138,732-byte JS payload and 1,298,912-byte total transfer, plus desktop frame timing averaging 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame and 1.22% long-frame ratio.
critique.fix: Reduce initial JavaScript through route-level code splitting and lazy-load the phylogeny/chart code. Profile desktop rendering to remove the 50 ms frame and stabilize tablet layout so CLS approaches zero.
